description: Migrate a flat config.json to nested structure and update all code that reads it.
instruction: This project has a flat `config.json` with keys like `db_host`, `db_port`, `cache_ttl`, and `app_name`. Migrate it to a nested structure: database settings go under a `"database"` key, cache settings under `"cache"`, and app settings under `"app"`. Then update every source file under `src/` that reads from the config to use the new nested paths. When you are done, `node --test` must pass.
